text:
Maya: Quick spike idea 1: operator "inbox" for automatic fallbacks with a dry-run toggle. Mock: https://figma.com/proto/fallback-inbox-dryrun
Ravi: Dry-run sounds great for runbooks. Should show "expected traffic shift" and "estimated token delta".
Sam: Add a quota-protection guard: if projected token burn > org-threshold, grey out full-redirect.
Leia: Telemetry: emit structured event `fallback_act_v1` with decision_id, route, trigger_type, action, operator, pre_weight, post_weight. Retain 90d and exportable.
Tomas: Also add header `X-Fallback-Decision` with UUID for trace joins. Sampling: 1% of traces while fallback is active, configurable.
ops-bot: ops-bot: nightly job: canary check passed, no fallbacks triggered.
Maya: UX: actions = ["ack & monitor", "gradual-reduction", "redirect", "snooze"]. Default = ack & monitor. Add confirmation modal that shows cost + risk estimate.
Ravi: RBAC: only senior oncall can redirect, others can propose reductions. Log reason (optional) for audit.
Sam: Auto-escalate: if errors persist after configured hysteresis window, escalate to redirect. Prevent oscillation via cooldown.
Leia: PII rule: sampled request snapshots must be redacted before export.
Tomas: I'll draft proto and BigQuery schema. Maya, can you add the dry-run flow to the mock?
Maya: Yep, will update figma and follow up.
